a.xlink:title: Acknowledge transmission-complete: disable TCIE and clear ISR.TC.
Enable the receiver and its DMA request line (CR1.RE, CR3.DMAR).
Disable the receiver and its DMA request line (CR1.RE, CR3.DMAR).
Start a DMA-based reception, completed on the IDLE line.
Receive data, blocking until a one-shot reception completes.
Called periodically to send commands to the Nextion LCD display via USART.
Transmit data, blocking until the transfer completes.
